basis: Approved implementation refinements following review; original canonical Drive sources remain unchanged. 2026-11-22: Eric asked for teach and build to be separate sessions.

refinements.before:
Choose a small relevant task in your app, or bring existing work. In a separate implementation conversation, give AI the intended behavior and constraints, make choices, question proposals and check the results. AI may write the code. Your requests, decisions and follow-ups can show how you applied the outcome; code and observed results show what the app does.

A useful handoff carries the selected outcome, task and necessary constraints. Leave room for your own direction rather than copying a complete ideal prompt. Build in `app/` in your fork. Learning and review do not require installing or running this documentation website.
refinements.after:
Choose a small relevant task in your app, or bring existing work. Apply the concept in a separate build session, not in the teaching conversation. Draft the handoff yourself from `templates/learning/HANDOFF.md`: your intended behavior, expectations, success check and constraints. Then make choices, question proposals and check the results. In the direct-agents lane the build agent may write all the code; in the write-code lane you write the parts you named. Your requests, decisions and follow-ups can show how you applied the outcome; code and observed results show what the app does.

The handoff carries the selected outcome, task, your expectations, constraints and the decisions that are yours, and asks the build agent to record what it did in `BUILD-NOTES.md`. Leave room for your own decisions rather than supplying a fully solved prompt. Build in `app/` in your fork or in your own project folder. Learning and review do not require installing or running this documentation website.
